metrics.name: mean_reward_per_click
metrics.description: Mean observed reward (z) across all clicks. Random clicking on the GP-sampled grids yields ~50; humans typically reach ~62-70 by exploiting smooth reward gradients (Witte et al. 2024).

metrics.name: mean_reward_safe
metrics.description: Mean reward in safe blocks (no Kraken). The relative ordering vs risky-block reward depends on whether the agent's caution boost in risky blocks outweighs the Kraken zero-outs.

metrics.name: mean_reward_risky
metrics.description: Mean per-click reward in risky blocks. Cautious humans tend to pick high-value tiles more often when the Kraken is present, often netting a slightly higher per-click mean even though block totals are reduced by Kraken zero-outs.

metrics.name: prop_high_value_clicks
metrics.description: Proportion of clicks with z>50 across all blocks. Random ~0.5; humans 0.7-0.8.

metrics.name: kraken_caught_rate_risky
metrics.description: Fraction of risky-block clicks that catch the Kraken (z_true<=50). Random ~0.5; humans should be much lower.
